name: JellyWatchParty
description: Watch movies together in sync with friends on Jellyfin
overview: Synchronized watch parties for Jellyfin. Create or join rooms to watch content together with friends, perfectly in sync.

versions.changelog: Hold Ctrl instead of X to draw shared cursors and trails. Both Ctrl keys are supported, and the owner and guest chat hints now show the new shortcut. The matching Gowo.io+ update changes both the room page and embedded player.
Updated the matching JellyWatchParty and Gowo.io+ emote pickers: Heart is now peepoLove, TrollDespair is replaced by TROLL, and PepePls is replaced by Aware. Existing chat tokens continue to render.

Fixes unpause immediately cancelling itself after briefly flashing the synchronization popup. Buffered HTML media queues Playing before the temporary Pause used to hold the owner. That queued event was clearing Pause suppression, so the owner's own hold was mistaken for a deliberate cancellation.

The client now preserves suppression until Pause consumes it and ignores stale Playing/Waiting notifications from already-paused media. Normal Pause, intentional countdown cancellation and buffering recovery still work.

Validation: reproduced the failure before the fix with a real local video, then verified owner/guest playback, repeated pause/resume and cancellation using native media events. Added regression coverage and a generated silent-video browser fixture; all 190 client/helper and 128 plugin tests passed. No watch history or session server changes.

Panel brightness now dims the entire chat panel, including text, buttons and emotes, against an opaque background for OLED viewing. 100% keeps the normal appearance, while 0% is near-black. Video brightness is unaffected.

The setting still previews immediately and saves on the device. It defaults to 80% and carries over percentages saved by the former opacity control. The settings label and documentation now describe brightness.

Validation: 188 client/helper tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Local browser checks covered host and guest panels, 0/50/80/100%, black and themed backgrounds, and persistence after reload. No session server changes are required.

Replaces RareParrot with VIBE by mathvaib in the chat picker, matching the Gowo.io+ update. The image is bundled for room owners and guests, while RareParrot remains supported in existing chat messages.

Validation: 188 client/helper tests, 128 plugin tests and 15 Gowo loader tests passed. No session server changes are required.

Hides the duplicate group launcher while joined to a watch party room. The arrow is now the single chat reopen control, including when the owner returns to the library. Leaving the room restores the normal lobby launcher.

Verified host and guest chat controls in the local browser, including player, waiting-room and library views. All 188 client/helper and 128 plugin tests passed. No session server changes are required.

Replaces Bonk with BOOBA, RainTime with uhh (the uuh upload by d_uc), FeelsStrongMan with Nerd by shahriil, nanaAYAYA with peepoComfy, and Fire with AINTNOWAY. The same catalog is published in Gowo.io+.

All five images are bundled for hosts and accountless guests. Retired emotes still render in existing chat messages.

Validation: 188 client/helper tests, 128 plugin tests, and 15 Gowo loader tests passed. No session server changes are required.

The docked player's controls now adapt to the width left beside chat, keeping fullscreen and the other buttons on one row. Narrow layouts compact the controls and remove secondary text before running out of space.

Play now immediately displays a synchronization indicator over the player, followed by the shared-start countdown for both owner and guests. Owners can cancel using the indicator or another play/pause click. Pause remains immediate.

Resume requests carry an optional identifier through the session server so replies from a cancelled request cannot restart the owner or replace a newer request. Cancellation follows the ordered server connection to guests. Buffer recovery no longer schedules an extra resume after an already coordinated start, and playback outside a room is no longer held for synchronization.

Validation: 188 client/helper tests, 128 plugin tests, and 118 Rust server tests passed. Local browser checks covered owner and guest feedback, cancellation, and docked control widths from 434px to 1077px. No media playback or watch-history changes were needed.

Update both the Jellyfin plugin and session service. Restarting the session service clears existing rooms; create a fresh room afterward.

The chat reopen arrow now occupies its own space at the far right of Jellyfin's player header, after the native controls, with a small gap and its existing translucent circular style. It no longer covers another player button and still fades with the native controls.

The arrow appears only while the user is in a room and chat is collapsed. Leaving the room hides it. Waiting and joining screens retain a separate accessible arrow outside the hidden Jellyfin header.

Validation: 180 client/helper tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Local browser checks covered host controls, room exit, playback outside a room, the waiting-to-player transition, and reopening chat in a 390px guest layout. No media was played and no watch history was changed.

The translucent chat reopen arrow now fades with Jellyfin's player controls and returns when the player controls return, for both hosts and guests. It follows Jellyfin's native idle timing and fade animation, stays accessible through keyboard focus, and remains visible while waiting for the owner to pick a title.

Validation: 177 client/helper tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Browser checks covered host and guest control visibility, the 390px guest layout, keyboard reopening, and the waiting room without playing media or changing watch history.

Removes the watch-party button from the video controls. Hosts and guests now reopen chat with a compact left arrow whose background is 50% transparent. Hiding the panel places this arrow where its hide button was, with no text label.

The arrow also provides access to the watch-party panel before joining a room. Draft preservation, waiting-room support, and guest player confinement remain intact.

Validation: 177 client/helper tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Browser checks verified the old button is removed, the arrow aligns with the hide button on desktop and phone layouts, the background has 50% opacity, and host/guest drafts survive reopening. No media playback was used. Compatible with the existing session server.

Adds Aloo by benASTRO to the chat emote picker. Select it in the picker or type `:aloo:`. The image is bundled for guests, and all existing emotes remain available.

Validation: 9 emote/bootstrap tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Compatible with the existing session server; no server update is required. Refresh Jellyfin to load the updated picker.

Guests now have the same Hide panel arrow as the host. A small Chat button reopens the panel from the player, including while waiting for a title. The player expands into the freed space on desktop and phone layouts.

Guest restrictions, routine room refreshes, and title transitions respect the collapsed panel. Drafts remain intact, hidden chat is not marked read during rerenders, and room-closure messages still appear. Guests remain confined to the player view.

Validation: 177 client/helper tests and 128 plugin tests passed. The included local browser fixture verifies desktop and phone collapse/reopen, draft retention, room refreshes, title transitions, closure, and library isolation without media playback. The existing session server remains compatible.

Replaces WAYTOODANK in the chat picker with RAGEY by KAETNN. Existing WAYTOODANK messages remain readable. Refresh Jellyfin to load the updated picker.

Validation: 9 emote/bootstrap tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Compatible with the existing session server; no server update is required.

Replaces PartyParrot in the chat picker with Prayge by Neowav. Existing PartyParrot messages remain readable. Refresh Jellyfin to load the updated picker.

Validation: 9 emote/bootstrap tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Compatible with the existing session server; no server update is required.

Chat panels now start with an 80% background opacity and include a slider in Chat settings. Changes preview immediately and persist on the device, while text and controls stay readable.

The emote picker now includes hi, NOOOO, catJAM, CAUGHT, peepoRun and TrollDespair from the requested 7TV creators. peepoRun appears once; retired tokens still render in existing chat history.

Validation: 175 client/helper tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Browser checks confirmed live opacity changes, persistence after reload, and theme support. This UI update works with the existing 1.11.0 session server.

Fix shared cursors and drawing trails being invisible to watch-party guests. The guest player visibility rules now include the body-mounted cursor, nickname and SVG trail overlays while playback is open. They remain hidden when the room closes, and library navigation stays restricted.

Validation: reproduced the missing drawings in a local browser fixture before the fix and verified visible host/guest trails afterward; closed-room and library-isolation checks passed. All 16 focused client tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Live cursor delivery and release events passed between three clients in an empty disposable room, with no media playback or watch-history changes.

No session-server changes are required. Refresh host and guest tabs after updating the plugin.
Fix the clipped chain icon on the Copy link button by keeping the SVG artwork inside its 24-unit frame. Verified in a local browser preview; all 128 plugin tests passed. No session-server changes.

Adds replies to watch-party chat. Choose Reply beside a message to quote it, cancel with the preview button or Escape, and send your response to everyone in the room.

Replies use server-assigned message IDs and server-resolved quotes, survive reconnects, and retain quoted text when older messages leave the bounded chat history. Direct and WebSocket copies merge without duplicate messages; failed sends keep the draft and reply selection.

Update both the Jellyfin plugin and the session server for replies. ShareLinks 1.0.8.0 remains compatible.

Validation: 172 JavaScript tests, 118 Rust tests, 128 plugin tests and Rust Clippy passed. Live guest/browser verification is recorded in the repository deployment notes.

Create a room, copy its link, and chat before choosing a title. Guest clients stay inside the player and chat through title changes, reloads, reconnects and room closure. Chat connects while Jellyfin prepares its native player; the client ships as one ordered bundle loaded early in the page.

Reconnects refresh authentication and restore room state. Separate tabs have separate identities, and resuming an old transport requires authentication as the same user. Paused title changes, the native player opening at a later timestamp, and room lock ordering are corrected.

Random Pick excludes movies and series already displayed in Continue Watching and Next Up. Reusable injector, deployment and disposable integration scripts are included under extras/jellyfin.

Validation: 155 client JavaScript tests, 8 Random Pick tests, 128 plugin tests, 116 server tests, Rust clippy, and live API/WebSocket/browser checks. Companion ShareLinks: 1.0.8.0.

Rakkate edition: account-free direct-to-player invites, whole-series rooms, docked themed chat, custom emotes, shared cursor trails, tighter playback sync, WebRTC fast path with WebSocket fallback, guest confinement, and owner-managed room lifecycle.
